name: pi-ext
description: Codex-style terminal UI and theme for Pi Coding Agent
author: Wang Xuyang

scripts.build: pnpm run clean && pnpm run build:codex-ui
scripts.check: pnpm run repository:check && pnpm run secrets:check && pnpm run build && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run typecheck:tests && pnpm test && pnpm run package:check && pnpm run host:check
scripts.codemode:check: pnpm run build:codex-ui && pnpm test extensions/codex-ui/__tests__/codemode*.test.ts && node extensions/codex-ui/__tests__/fixtures/codemode-cli.mjs --smoke && node extensions/codex-ui/__tests__/fixtures/codemode-benchmark.mjs && conda run -n codex-py312 python extensions/codex-ui/__tests__/codemode-pty.py && conda run -n codex-py312 python extensions/codex-ui/__tests__/codemode-pty.py --fullscreen
scripts.tool-status:check: pnpm run build && conda run -n codex-py312 python extensions/codex-ui/__tests__/fixtures/tool-status/smoke.py --play --restart && conda run -n codex-py312 python extensions/codex-ui/__tests__/fixtures/tool-status/smoke.py --play --fullscreen --restart
